Alistar.build: Alistar Q Pulverize, Alistar W Headbutt, and Alistar E Trample all deal magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Don’t prioritize armor to withstand this matchup’s damage.
Alistar.fight: As soon as Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt are down, close the gap with Maokai W Twisted Advance. Engage only when your allied ranged carry can follow up with basic attacks. If Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, don’t spend your damage on Alistar; back off and wait out its duration.
Alistar.teamfight: When Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, don’t spend your abilities on Alistar; target the damage dealer behind him. If Alistar gets onto your allied damage dealer, knock him away with Maokai Q Bramble Smash and root him with Maokai W Twisted Advance. Even if Alistar R Unbreakable Will removes existing crowd control, you can stop his engage again with Maokai W Twisted Advance or Maokai R Nature’s Grasp afterward.
Alistar.laning: Use Maokai E Sapling Toss to control the bottom lane bushes. When the enemy steps forward, use Maokai W Twisted Advance when the enemy is within your allied ranged carry’s attack range. Don’t force the wave forward, and save Maokai Q Bramble Smash to counter an engage. When Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt are down, use that opening to reposition.
Alistar.combo: When Alistar W Headbutt is down, attack in this order: Maokai W Twisted Advance → a basic attack empowered by Maokai P Sap Magic → Maokai Q Bramble Smash.
Alistar.escape: Alistar W Headbutt is his only mobility tool, so right after he uses it is an opening to engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance. If Alistar Q Pulverize is down too, use the opportunity to close the gap or catch him out, and prevent his escape with Maokai R Nature’s Grasp.
Alistar.watch: Watch out for Alistar Q Pulverize’s knock-up and Alistar W Headbutt’s forced displacement. Near a turret, especially, don’t give Alistar room to get behind you and knock you into turret range. Alistar E Trample can stun you afterward, so be wary of his engage.

Brand.teamfight: Spread out from your allies to prevent Brand E Conflagration from spreading and Brand R Pyroclasm from bouncing, and don’t stand beside an ally who is ablaze. From a flank in a narrow corridor, use Maokai R Nature’s Grasp to look for a root. If you need to protect your allies instead of engaging, stay beside your allied damage dealers, knock the enemy away with Maokai Q Bramble Smash, and root them with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Brand.laning: Use Maokai E Sapling Toss to control the bushes, and don’t last-hit beside a minion Brand has set ablaze. Don’t force the wave forward; keep it near your side to leave room to get out after using Maokai W Twisted Advance. Engage only when your allied ranged carry can follow up with basic attacks.
Brand.build: Brand deals magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Brand P Blaze deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid relying on health alone. Movement speed also helps you get out of telegraphed attack areas.
Brand.combo: When Brand W Pillar of Flame is down, attack in this order: Maokai W Twisted Advance → a basic attack empowered by Maokai P Sap Magic → Maokai Q Bramble Smash. If you use Maokai Q Bramble Smash first, Brand will be pushed away and the gap will widen. Start Maokai R Nature’s Grasp from far away to extend the root, then follow up with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility, so the moment after he uses a poke ability is your chance to engage. In particular, close the gap with Maokai W Twisted Advance when Brand W Pillar of Flame is down and you aren’t ablaze. If you are ablaze, dodge the stun from Brand Q Sear first.
Brand.fight: Right after Brand W Pillar of Flame is used, close in with Maokai W Twisted Advance if your allies are in range to attack with you. If you’re ablaze, dodge the stun from Brand Q Sear before engaging. Once you’re on him, fight while healing with basic attacks empowered by Maokai P Sap Magic.
Brand.phase: In the late game, your sapling explosion damage and durability increase together, letting you continue to initiate, but keep your distance to avoid Brand’s area damage.
Brand.watch: Brand P Blaze explodes when its stacks build up, so it’s important to dodge his spells starting with the very first one. If you’re ablaze, watch for the stun from Brand Q Sear: move out of the projectile’s path or stand behind a minion. When you see Brand R Pyroclasm being cast, spread out from your allies.

Hwei.fight: When Hwei uses Hwei E Subject: Torment to poke or clear minions, engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance if your allied damage dealer can follow up. Hwei has no mobility, so closing the gap and rooting him is your opportunity.
Hwei.laning: Use Maokai E Sapling Toss to control the bottom lane bushes, and when Hwei steps forward, use Maokai W Twisted Advance from within your allied damage dealer’s attack range. Don’t force the wave forward; keep it near your side to leave room to get out after engaging. If Hwei has left an eye with Hwei E Subject: Torment, change your engage path or send a minion ahead to trigger it first.
Hwei.build: Build magic resistance first against Hwei’s damage, and avoid relying on health alone because Hwei Q Subject: Disaster deals damage based on your maximum health. Get movement speed to help you leave telegraphed attack areas. If your allied damage dealer is caught by crowd control from Hwei E Subject: Torment and then focused, prioritize Mikael’s Blessing over Locket of the Iron Solari.
Hwei.combo: When Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, trade in this order: Maokai W Twisted Advance → a basic attack empowered by Maokai P Sap Magic → Maokai Q Bramble Smash. Follow this order because using Maokai Q Bramble Smash first will push Hwei away and widen the gap. If you start with Maokai R Nature’s Grasp, cast it from far away to extend the root, then follow up with Maokai W Twisted Advance using the movement speed gained on hit.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility, so right after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used, you have an opening to engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance. Check whether it has been used; if it’s still available, the first champion to engage could be rooted or forced back.
Hwei.phase: In the late game, health items increase both your sapling explosion damage and durability, so continue to initiate.
Hwei.teamfight: From the side of a narrow corridor, such as the entrance to Dragon or Baron pit, use Maokai R Nature’s Grasp, then close in with Maokai W Twisted Advance once Hwei E Subject: Torment is down. Take a wide route around corridors covered by Hwei’s attacks. If you need to protect your allied damage dealers, stay beside them, knock away an approaching enemy with Maokai Q Bramble Smash, and root them with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Hwei.watch: If you’re rooted or pulled in by Hwei E Subject: Torment, you’re likely to take follow-up damage, so don’t lead the engage while that ability is available. If one of Hwei’s abilities hits you, move immediately to avoid a second ability and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.

Lulu.laning: Distribute Maokai E Sapling Toss between both bushes to make it difficult for Lulu to use them. Stand behind minions to reduce the bonus damage from Lulu P Pix, Faerie Companion, and trade with your allied damage dealer when Lulu steps forward. Don’t force the wave or waste Maokai Q Bramble Smash on minions.
Lulu.teamfight: Cast Maokai R Nature’s Grasp from a distance along a flank or narrow passage to look for a root, then follow up with Maokai W Twisted Advance if it hits. If Lulu R Wild Growth is available, consider targeting Lulu herself or someone else instead of focusing only on the target she’s protecting. When you need to protect rather than engage, stand beside your allied damage dealer, knock away an enemy with Maokai Q Bramble Smash, then root them with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Lulu.watch: Lulu W Whimsy silences you and prevents you from attacking, so don’t engage first with Maokai W Twisted Advance while it’s available. Lulu R Wild Growth increases its target’s health and knocks up nearby enemies, so while she can use R, don’t overcommit to the target your allies are focusing. Also dodge Lulu Q Glitterlance’s slow.
Lulu.escape: Lulu has no dash to create distance herself, so the moment after Lulu W Whimsy is used on another ally is your chance to engage. When Lulu E Help, Pix! is used on an allied carry, you can target Lulu herself with Maokai W Twisted Advance. If Lulu R Wild Growth is available, account for its ability to knock up nearby enemies and save its target.
Lulu.build: The information isn’t enough to determine your first purchase. If Lulu’s damage is a concern, magic resistance is more effective than armor. Choose overall resistances based on the damage type of the target Lulu is protecting, and consider tenacity against Lulu W Whimsy and Lulu R Wild Growth.
Lulu.combo: When Lulu W Whimsy is down, use Maokai W Twisted Advance → a passive-empowered basic attack → Maokai Q Bramble Smash. If you use Maokai Q Bramble Smash first, Lulu gets knocked back and the gap opens. To initiate with Maokai R Nature’s Grasp, send the wall from a distance, then use the movement speed it grants to follow up with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Lulu.fight: Use Maokai E Sapling Toss to harass around the pathways, then engage after Lulu W Whimsy is used on another ally. Root Lulu with Maokai W Twisted Advance from within range for your allied marksman to land basic attacks. If Lulu E Help, Pix! is used on an allied carry, you have an opportunity to target Lulu herself.
Lulu.phase: As you build health items in the late game, sapling explosions and durability increase, letting you continue initiating fights and protecting allies.

Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits you, it’s hard to dodge her follow-up abilities, so bait out Q first and dodge it. Q roots the first two enemies hit, so don’t stand in a line with your allies. Sidestep when you see the red targeting line for Lux R Final Spark.
Lux.fight: Bait out Lux Q Light Binding and make it miss, then close in with Maokai W Twisted Advance when your allied damage dealer can attack alongside you. Lux has no mobility ability, so she’s easy to catch once you close the gap, and Maokai’s magic damage also deals good damage to her.
Lux.laning: Use Maokai E Sapling Toss to control both bottom-lane bushes, and stand apart from your allies so you can dodge Lux Q Light Binding. Don’t force the wave forward; stay on your side and look for an opening when Lux steps up. Don’t waste Maokai Q Bramble Smash on minions.
Lux.teamfight: Approach from different directions, spread out from your allies, so you don’t all get caught by Lux E Lucent Singularity. From a flank or narrow passage, send Maokai R Nature’s Grasp from a distance to look for a root. If your allied damage dealer needs more protection, stand beside them, knock away an enemy who engages with Maokai Q Bramble Smash, then root them with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Lux.build: Build magic resistance against Lux’s damage. If your allied damage dealer is rooted by Lux Q Light Binding and killed by the follow-up damage, buy Mikael’s Blessing before Locket of the Iron Solari. Also build tenacity to help against being caught in her combo after Q hits.
Lux.combo: When Lux Q Light Binding misses, attack in this order: Maokai W Twisted Advance → a passive-empowered basic attack → Maokai Q Bramble Smash. If you use Maokai Q Bramble Smash first, Lux gets knocked back and the gap opens. If you have an angle to initiate from far away, send Maokai R Nature’s Grasp first and follow up with W.
Lux.escape: Right after Lux Q Light Binding is down is your chance to engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance. Lux has no mobility ability to create distance herself, so approach from a flank or a bush and catch her.
Lux.phase: As you build health items in the late game, sapling explosions and durability both increase, letting you continue initiating fights.

Nautilus.fight: Right after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses is your chance to engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance. Go in when your allied damage dealer can land basic attacks. While Nautilus is rooted, heal with a basic attack empowered by Maokai P Sap Magic, then use Maokai Q Bramble Smash. If Nautilus uses E Riptide right beside you, don't jump in before the wave ends.
Nautilus.laning: Plant Maokai E Sapling Toss in both side bushes to control them. Dodge Nautilus Q Dredge Line with minions between you, and trade when Q misses and your allied damage dealer can follow up. Don't force the wave forward or waste Maokai Q Bramble Smash on clearing minions.
Nautilus.teamfight: Nautilus R Depth Charge knocks up allies along its path, so don't stand on top of an allied damage dealer. If Nautilus engages on them, stand between them and Nautilus, knock him away with Maokai Q Bramble Smash, then root him with Maokai W Twisted Advance. If you can start the fight, send Maokai R Nature's Grasp from afar through a flank or narrow passage.
Nautilus.watch: Nautilus Q Dredge Line starts his engage and kill pressure, so dodge it with minions between you. Nautilus P Staggering Blow roots with his first basic attack, so don't stay within basic attack range after trading. Nautilus R Depth Charge follows its target and knocks up allies along its path, so don't stand on top of an ally while Nautilus has his ultimate.
Nautilus.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for the main damage from Nautilus Q Dredge Line, W Titan's Wrath, and E Riptide. If an allied damage dealer is caught in Nautilus's crowd control and focused, prioritize Mikael's Blessing over Locket of the Iron Solari.
Nautilus.combo: When Nautilus Q Dredge Line is down, trade in this order: Maokai W Twisted Advance → a basic attack empowered by Maokai P Sap Magic → Maokai Q Bramble Smash. To send Nautilus toward your allies, land beyond him with Maokai W Twisted Advance, then knock him back with Maokai Q Bramble Smash. Start Maokai R Nature's Grasp from far away to secure root time, then follow up with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Nautilus.escape: Right after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses, his engage tool is down, so go in with Maokai W Twisted Advance. After trading, get out of range of Nautilus P Staggering Blow's basic attack to avoid further crowd control.
Nautilus.phase: In the late game, more health items increase both Maokai's sapling burst and durability, letting him keep initiating fights.

Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs can root multiple targets and is more threatening to those behind the first target, so don't stand on top of an ally. If Neeko approaches while transformed, you may not see the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom, so spread out as soon as a suspicious enemy gets close. Don't chase Neeko W Shapesplitter's clone; track the real Neeko.
Neeko.laning: In the bottom lane, control both side bushes with Maokai E Sapling Toss, and use Maokai W Twisted Advance when Neeko steps forward and your allied damage dealer can reach her with basic attacks. Don't force the wave forward, leaving room to retreat after engaging. Save Maokai Q Bramble Smash to counter Neeko's engage instead of wasting it on minions.
Neeko.teamfight: Watch for Neeko approaching while transformed, and spread out from allies so you aren't caught together by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and Neeko R Pop Blossom. If an engage is expected, block the approach with Maokai E Sapling Toss. Knock Neeko away from an allied damage dealer with Maokai Q Bramble Smash, then root her with Maokai W Twisted Advance. If you can start the fight, send Maokai R Nature's Grasp from afar through a flank or narrow passage.
Neeko.build: Build magic resistance first since Neeko's main damage is magic. If being rooted by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and then hit by Neeko R Pop Blossom leads to your death, prioritize tenacity. If an allied damage dealer is caught in Neeko's crowd control and focused down, prioritize Mikael's Blessing over Locket of the Iron Solari.
Neeko.combo: Your basic trade is Maokai W Twisted Advance → a basic attack empowered by Maokai P Sap Magic → Maokai Q Bramble Smash. To send Neeko toward your allies, land on the other side of her with Maokai W Twisted Advance, then use Maokai Q Bramble Smash. If you start with Maokai R Nature's Grasp, cast it from far away so the wall travels, then follow it with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Neeko.escape: Right after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down is your chance to engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance. If you chain Maokai R Nature's Grasp then, Neeko will have a hard time escaping.
Neeko.fight: Right after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down, engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance to force a trade. Go in when your allied damage dealer can attack, and walk out of the area where Neeko Q Blooming Burst lands. Maokai's magic damage is effective against Neeko's low magic resistance.
Neeko.phase: In the late game, use Maokai E Sapling Toss to control approach routes, protect allied damage dealers, and look for chances to initiate.

Rakan.laning: Plant Maokai E Sapling Toss across both side bushes to stop Rakan from using them. Don't force the wave forward; keep it closer to your side, and only start a trade with Maokai W Twisted Advance when your allied damage dealer can land basic attacks. Save Maokai Q Bramble Smash to counter Rakan's engage instead of wasting it on minions.
Rakan.teamfight: If Rakan engages with W Grand Entrance, root him with Maokai W Twisted Advance right after he lands. If he reaches an allied damage dealer, stand between them and Rakan and knock him away with Maokai Q Bramble Smash. Don't line up with allies where Rakan R The Quickness can hit multiple people. To initiate, send Maokai R Nature's Grasp from far away through a flank or narrow passage, then follow with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Rakan.escape: Right after dodging or baiting out Rakan W Grand Entrance is your window to close the gap with Maokai W Twisted Advance. If Rakan is separated from his allies, he can't escape to an ally with Rakan E Battle Dance, so catch him then. Before Rakan R The Quickness reaches you, root him first with Maokai W Twisted Advance or Maokai R Nature's Grasp.
Rakan.build: Rakan starts fights with Rakan W Grand Entrance and Rakan R The Quickness, so secure a crowd control cleanse first. If you build resistance, choose magic resistance, which is effective against Rakan's damage.
Rakan.combo: The basic order is Maokai W Twisted Advance → a basic attack empowered by passive healing → Maokai Q Bramble Smash. Keep this order, since using Maokai Q Bramble Smash first knocks Rakan away and creates distance. If you can initiate from afar, root him first with Maokai R Nature's Grasp, then follow with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Rakan.fight: Look to trade right after the shield from Rakan P Fey Feathers breaks. Dodge Rakan W Grand Entrance's landing or wait until the ability is down, then engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance from a range where your allied damage dealer can attack. You also have a chance to catch Rakan when he moves alone, away from his allies.
Rakan.phase: In the late game, sapling burst and durability both increase, letting you keep initiating. Focus on protecting allied damage dealers if Rakan's engage threatens them.
Rakan.watch: Rakan W Grand Entrance has a visible landing point, so sidestep as soon as his dash starts to avoid the knockup. When Rakan R The Quickness is active, it's hard to escape on foot, so don't line up with allies; root him with Maokai W Twisted Advance or Maokai R Nature's Grasp before he reaches you.

Renata.laning: Control both side bushes with Maokai E Sapling Toss, and attack Renata Glasc together with your ranged allied damage dealer when she steps forward. Don't force the wave forward so it's easier to retreat after using Maokai W Twisted Advance, and save Maokai Q Bramble Smash to counter an enemy engage.
Renata.teamfight: Don't engage grouped up while Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available; spread out. In a narrow passage, send Maokai R Nature's Grasp from the side. Right after an enemy affected by Renata Glasc W Bailout is taken down, retreat so your allies aren't killed. If initiating is difficult, stand beside an allied damage dealer, knock away an enemy who engages with Maokai Q Bramble Smash, then root them with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Renata.escape: Renata Glasc has no innate mobility, so close the gap with Maokai W Twisted Advance as soon as Renata Glasc Q Handshake is down. If Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is also down, it's a much better window to engage with your allies.
Renata.build: Build magic resistance against the damage from Renata Glasc P Leverage, Q Handshake, and E Loyalty Program. If an allied damage dealer is immobilized and focused down by abilities such as Renata Glasc Q Handshake, buy Mikael's Blessing before Locket of the Iron Solari.
Renata.combo: Your basic trade is to root with Maokai W Twisted Advance, heal with a basic attack empowered by your passive, then finish with Maokai Q Bramble Smash. If you start with Maokai R Nature's Grasp, send the wall from far away to extend the root duration, then follow with Maokai W Twisted Advance using the movement speed increase.
Renata.fight: When Renata Glasc Q Handshake is down and your ranged allied damage dealer is in attack range, catch Renata Glasc with Maokai W Twisted Advance. Maokai W Twisted Advance can also dodge targeted attacks while casting, so engage when that value matters instead of always using it first.
Renata.phase: In the late game, Maokai can keep initiating or protecting allied damage dealers with saplings and durability.
Renata.watch: Renata Glasc Q Handshake roots the first enemy hit and throws them, potentially stunning allies too, so avoid it from behind minions or your frontline. Keep your distance from allies when engaging while Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available.

Seraphine.laning: Control the bottom-lane bushes with Maokai E Sapling Toss and wait for Seraphine to step forward. Keep the wave closer to your side, and only engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance from a range where your allied damage dealer can attack. Don't waste Maokai Q Bramble Smash on clearing minions.
Seraphine.teamfight: Spread out to the sides from allies so Seraphine R Encore doesn't hit multiple people in sequence. Initiate with Maokai R Nature's Grasp through a narrow passage or from a flank, and place saplings at separate points along the enemy's approach routes. When you need to protect an allied damage dealer, stand beside them, knock away an enemy who engages with Maokai Q Bramble Smash, then root them with W Twisted Advance.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets. If you're slowed, move out of the straight line in front of Seraphine. In team fights, spread out to the sides so Seraphine R Encore's charm doesn't reach allies behind you.
Seraphine.fight: Trade when Seraphine is separated from her ranged damage dealer and your allied damage dealer can land basic attacks. If Seraphine E Beat Drop is down, engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance and root her. Keep Seraphine W Surround Sound's shield, healing, and movement speed increase in mind; don't overextend alone.
Seraphine.build: Build magic resistance against the magic damage from Seraphine P Stage Presence, Q High Note, and E Beat Drop. If an allied damage dealer is caught in Seraphine's immobilizing crowd control and focused down, prioritize Mikael's Blessing over Locket of the Iron Solari.
Seraphine.combo: The basic order is Maokai W Twisted Advance → a basic attack empowered by your passive → Q Bramble Smash. After Seraphine E Beat Drop is down, root her with W, heal with a basic attack, then use Q. If you start with Maokai R Nature's Grasp, cast from a distance to extend the root duration, then follow with W using the movement speed increase.
Seraphine.escape: Right after dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop is your chance to engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance. Seraphine has no mobility, so close the gap and root her then, followed by Maokai R Nature's Grasp to catch her again.
Seraphine.phase: In the late game, more health items increase both sapling burst and durability, so keep initiating and protecting allies.

Soraka.laning: Use Maokai E Sapling Toss to control the bottom-lane bushes, and don’t force the wave forward. Pressure Soraka’s ranged damage dealer to draw out Soraka W Astral Infusion, but dodge Soraka Q Starcall so she can’t recover health. Engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance only when your allied damage dealer can land basic attacks.
Soraka.watch: Soraka E Equinox silences and can then root you, so engage before stepping into its zone or wait for it to end. If Soraka Q Starcall hits, she heals and gains movement speed, so dodge it. Soraka R Wish heals her allies regardless of distance, so keep it in mind even when trying to finish an enemy.
Soraka.fight: When Soraka E Equinox is down, root her with Maokai W Twisted Advance if your allied damage dealer is in range to attack. Focus your damage in a short window so she has no time to heal with Soraka W Astral Infusion or R Wish.
Soraka.build: Build magic resistance first to counter the magic damage from Soraka Q Starcall and E Equinox. If Soraka’s healing extends fights, get Grievous Wounds next.
Soraka.combo: Send Maokai R Nature’s Grasp from range to look for a root, then follow up with Maokai W Twisted Advance when you gain the movement speed bonus. Once you’re on top of her, recover with a Maokai P Sap Magic empowered basic attack and cast Maokai Q Bramble Smash. Don’t cast Maokai Q Bramble Smash first and create distance from Soraka.
Soraka.escape: Engage when you see Soraka E Equinox used to harass or clear the wave.
Soraka.phase: In the late game, build health items to increase sapling explosions and durability, and take on the role of engaging or protecting your allies.
Soraka.teamfight: Root Soraka herself and focus your attacks on her rather than continuously hitting the enemy being healed. From a narrow passage or flank, send Maokai R Nature’s Grasp from far enough away, then follow up with Maokai W Twisted Advance. If an enemy is on top of your allied damage dealer, stay by your ally, use Maokai Q Bramble Smash to knock the enemy away, and protect your ally by rooting the enemy with Maokai W Twisted Advance.

Thresh.laning: Use Maokai E Sapling Toss to control both bushes, and don’t force the wave forward. When the lane is close to your side, look for the moment Thresh steps forward while staying with your allied ranged damage dealer. Save Maokai Q Bramble Smash to respond to an enemy engage instead of wasting it on minions.
Thresh.watch: Be especially careful of Thresh Q Death Sentence when stepping up to last-hit. When you see him raise his hook, change direction sideways, and avoid the line between Thresh and his allies so Thresh E Flay doesn’t pull you toward them.
Thresh.build: All of Thresh’s ability damage is magic, so build magic resistance before armor. If the situation involves being caught by Thresh Q Death Sentence and Thresh E Flay, then taking damage from allies, consider tenacity as well.
Thresh.combo: The basic combo is Maokai W Twisted Advance → a passive-empowered basic attack → Maokai Q Bramble Smash. To send Thresh toward your allies, use Maokai W Twisted Advance to pass through him and land on the other side, then cast Maokai Q Bramble Smash.
Thresh.escape: The moment after dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence is an opportunity to close the gap. If Thresh W Dark Passage is also down and hasn’t returned, engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance and follow up with Maokai R Nature’s Grasp.
Thresh.fight: Dodge Thresh Q Death Sentence sideways to make him use it, then close the gap. When Thresh steps forward to collect souls, engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance to start a trade if your allied ranged damage dealer is in range to land basic attacks.
Thresh.phase: Maokai keeps his engage role in the late game, but Thresh gains armor as he collects souls, so harass him when he steps forward to collect them.
Thresh.teamfight: From a narrow passage or flank, start Maokai R Nature’s Grasp from range to extend its root duration, then follow up with the movement speed it grants when it hits an enemy champion. If Thresh W Dark Passage comes out, immediately use your finishing ability or back off. If it’s difficult to engage, stay beside your allied damage dealer, use Maokai Q Bramble Smash to knock away an enemy who has engaged, and root them with Maokai W Twisted Advance.

Zilean.escape: Zilean has no mobility ability, so engage after Zilean E Time Warp is down or after you dodge the stun combo from Zilean Q Time Bomb. If you go in alone, Zilean E Time Warp can slow you and leave you vulnerable to the bomb combo, so approach with allies from multiple directions.
Zilean.laning: Use Maokai E Sapling Toss to control the bushes, and pressure Zilean with your allied damage dealer when he steps forward. Don’t force the wave forward; keep it close to your side to make it easier to get out after using Maokai W Twisted Advance. Don’t waste Maokai Q Bramble Smash on minions.
Zilean.watch: If two bombs from Zilean Q Time Bomb attach, they stun, so when the first bomb attaches, move away from your allies and out of the blast radius. Don’t use abilities on a target while Zilean R Chronoshift is reviving them.
Zilean.build: Build tenacity first to prepare for getting caught by the slow from Zilean E Time Warp and the stun from Zilean Q Time Bomb. Then build magic resistance to withstand Zilean’s magic damage.
Zilean.combo: Root Zilean with Maokai W Twisted Advance, recover with a Maokai P Sap Magic empowered basic attack, then cast Maokai Q Bramble Smash. If you cast Maokai Q Bramble Smash first, Zilean is knocked away and you create distance. You can also root him from range with Maokai R Nature’s Grasp, then follow up with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Zilean.fight: Engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance after Zilean E Time Warp is used on another target or after you dodge his bomb combo.
Zilean.phase: In the late game, use saplings and your durability to guard an approach or protect an allied damage dealer.
Zilean.teamfight: Move away from an ally who has a Zilean Q Time Bomb attached to avoid the area stun. In narrow passages, cast Maokai R Nature’s Grasp from long range or a flank. You can target Zilean himself, who is squishy, instead of the target affected by Zilean R Chronoshift. If protecting your allies matters more than engaging, stay by your allied damage dealer, use Maokai Q Bramble Smash to knock away an enemy, and root them with Maokai W Twisted Advance.

Ashe.build: Ashe’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If the enemy team’s damage is also mostly physical, consider Dead Man’s Plate or Thornmail. Armor won’t mitigate the magic damage from Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow.
Ashe.laning: Use Maokai E Sapling Toss to control the bottom lane bushes, and engage when Ashe steps forward only if she is within your allied ranged carry’s basic attack range. Don’t force the wave forward; this makes it easier to get back out after using Maokai W Twisted Advance. Don’t waste Maokai Q Bramble Smash on minions.
Ashe.combo: If you use Maokai Q Bramble Smash first, Ashe will be pushed away and the gap will widen. You can also root her from range with Maokai R Nature’s Grasp, then use the movement speed increase to follow up with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Ashe.escape: Look to engage as soon as Ashe W Volley is down. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is down too, you can look for an opening without worrying about its stun. Ashe has no ability to create distance on her own, so close in with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Ashe.fight: Look to trade after Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger’s Focus has ended. Walking up will leave you slowed by Ashe P Frost Shot, so use Maokai W Twisted Advance to close the gap in one move when your allied ranged carry can attack.
Ashe.phase: In the late game, keep initiating. Your saplings get stronger as you build health items, and your durability lets you continue the engage role.
Ashe.teamfight: From a flank or in a narrow corridor, cast Maokai R Nature’s Grasp from far enough away to limit Ashe’s room to dodge. When Ashe is rooted, follow with Maokai W Twisted Advance to catch her. If you need to protect your allied damage dealers, stay beside them, knock away the enemy engaging with Maokai Q Bramble Smash, and root them with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Ashe.watch: Ashe P Frost Shot’s slow is refreshed with every basic attack, so don’t stay within her basic attack range for long. Move sideways to dodge Ashe W Volley, and create distance while Ashe Q Ranger’s Focus is active. While Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, don’t start a skirmish from outside vision.

Braum.laning: Use Maokai E Sapling Toss to control the bottom lane bushes, and keep a minion in the path of Braum Q Winter’s Bite. Don’t force the wave forward; when the Braum side steps forward near your side of the lane, start a trade with Maokai W Twisted Advance. Don’t waste Maokai Q Bramble Smash on minions; save it to counter an engage.
Braum.teamfight: Don’t focus your allies’ damage into the front Braum E Unbreakable is facing; target the person he’s protecting from the side or another route. When the enemy enters a narrow corridor, cast Maokai R Nature’s Grasp from range and follow up with Maokai W Twisted Advance. If the situation makes initiating difficult, stay beside your allied damage dealers, knock away an enemy who gets close with Maokai Q Bramble Smash, and root them with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Braum.phase: In the late game, health items increase both Maokai E Sapling Toss’s explosion damage and your durability, so continue initiating and protecting your allies.
Braum.build: Build magic resistance first. Braum P Concussive Blows, Q Winter’s Bite, and R Glacial Fissure deal magic damage, and Braum has no ability that reduces your resistances or deals true damage.
Braum.combo: Your basic combo is Maokai W Twisted Advance → a basic attack empowered by your passive → Maokai Q Bramble Smash. If you need to push the enemy toward your team, use Maokai W Twisted Advance to pass them and land on the other side, then cast Maokai Q Bramble Smash. If you can initiate from range, cast Maokai R Nature’s Grasp to root them first, then follow up with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Braum.escape: Right after you force Braum to use Braum W Stand Behind Me, you have an opportunity to close in with Maokai W Twisted Advance. If you follow up with Maokai R Nature’s Grasp from range at that point, it will be hard for Braum to get away. If Braum P Concussive Blows is stacking marks on you, move out of range before the stun triggers.
Braum.fight: Close the gap and fight just after Braum W Stand Behind Me is down. When your allied ranged carry can follow up with basic attacks, engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance to root him, heal with an empowered basic attack, then use Maokai Q Bramble Smash. If Braum E Unbreakable is blocking from the front, wait for his shield to drop or find an angle from the side.
Braum.watch: Braum Q Winter’s Bite hits the first enemy it reaches, so stand behind minions to dodge it. If Braum P Concussive Blows marks you, move out of range before the stun stacks are completed. Watch Braum R Glacial Fissure’s cast animation and dodge to the side of its path; don’t step into the slow zone it leaves behind.

Milio.build: Choose resistances based on the enemy damage dealer’s damage type rather than focusing only on Milio. Magic resistance is useful against the damage from Milio P Fired Up! and Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick. If the healing from Milio W Cozy Campfire and Milio R Breath of Life is a problem, get healing reduction earlier.
Milio.laning: Use Maokai E Sapling Toss to control both bushes and make them difficult for Milio to use. Don’t force the wave forward; keep it on your side and catch an enemy who steps up with Maokai W Twisted Advance alongside your allied marksman. Save Maokai Q Bramble Smash for fights and to counter an enemy engage rather than wasting it on minions.
Milio.teamfight: If Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, initiate from a flank or narrow passage with Maokai R Nature’s Grasp, then target Milio himself, who has no mobility, with Maokai W Twisted Advance. Taking Milio out first greatly reduces the enemy team’s sustain. If you need to protect allies rather than engage, stand beside your damage dealer, knock away an enemy who gets close with Maokai Q Bramble Smash, then root them with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Milio.combo: When Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, use Maokai W Twisted Advance → an empowered basic attack → Maokai Q Bramble Smash. If you use Maokai Q Bramble Smash first, the enemy gets knocked back and the gap opens. If you can initiate with Maokai R Nature’s Grasp from a distance, use the movement speed it grants on hit to follow up with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Milio.escape: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is Milio’s only disengage tool, so the moment after he uses it is your chance to engage. Close the gap and root him with Maokai W Twisted Advance. When following up with Maokai R Nature’s Grasp, make sure it has room to travel.
Milio.fight: When Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down and your allied marksman can land basic attacks, close in with Maokai W Twisted Advance. Maokai’s magic damage deals good damage to Milio, who has low magic resistance.
Milio.phase: Milio’s team composition gets stronger as the game goes on, so create attrition trades early and keep using your saplings and engage tools in the late game.
Milio.watch: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick knocks back the first target it hits, so check whether he has used it before engaging. Delay frontline fights while Milio W Cozy Campfire is active and extends the enemy marksman’s range. The shield and movement speed from Milio E Warm Hugs and the healing and tenacity from Milio R Breath of Life can also help the enemy survive after you engage.

Pantheon.fight: When Pantheon uses E Aegis Assault, don't damage him from the front; wait for it to end or angle in from the side. Once Pantheon's mobility is down, fight with Maokai W Twisted Advance when your allies can attack with you.
Pantheon.laning: Plant Maokai E Sapling Toss across the bushes, and don't force the wave forward so there's room to trade on your side. Save Maokai Q Bramble Smash to counter Pantheon's engage instead of wasting it on minions.
Pantheon.build: Build armor first against Pantheon's main physical damage, and consider Dead Man's Plate or Thornmail. Use Maokai P Sap Magic's healing to last longer, but avoid stacking only health because Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your maximum health.
Pantheon.combo: Once Pantheon's engage tool is down, root him with Maokai W Twisted Advance, heal with a basic attack empowered by Maokai P Sap Magic, then use Maokai Q Bramble Smash. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, wait for it to end or move around to the side to deal damage. If you can root him first from afar with Maokai R Nature's Grasp, use the movement speed increase to follow up with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Pantheon.escape: Don't enter Pantheon W Shield Vault range first while it's available. If only one of Pantheon W Shield Vault and Pantheon R Grand Starfall is down, account for the other mobility tool. In particular, engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance and Maokai R Nature's Grasp before Pantheon R Grand Starfall comes back up.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon's influence falls off in the late game, while Maokai can keep initiating with health items and saplings.
Pantheon.teamfight: From a flank near a narrow passage, such as the entrance to the Dragon or Baron pit, send Maokai R Nature's Grasp from afar. If Pantheon engages on an allied damage dealer, stand between them and Pantheon, knock him away with Maokai Q Bramble Smash, then root him with Maokai W Twisted Advance. Before an objective fight, plant Maokai E Sapling Toss across each approach route.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault is a targeted stun, so it is safe to stay out of its range. When Pantheon uses Q Comet Spear to poke, keep minions between you. If you see the landing warning for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its area.

Velkoz.combo: When Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption is down, trade with Maokai W Twisted Advance → a passive-empowered basic attack → Maokai Q Bramble Smash. If you cast Maokai Q Bramble Smash first, Vel’Koz is knocked away, so don’t change the order. To send him toward your allies, use Maokai W Twisted Advance to pass through him and land on the other side, then cast Maokai Q Bramble Smash.
Velkoz.fight: After Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption misses, engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance when your allied damage dealer can land basic attacks. Vel’Koz has no mobility ability, so closing the gap then makes it easier to keep him caught.
Velkoz.laning: Use Maokai E Sapling Toss to control the bottom-lane bushes and look for when Vel’Koz steps forward to farm CS. Don’t force the wave forward; keep it close to your side to leave room to engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance and get back out. Don’t waste Maokai Q Bramble Smash on minions.
Velkoz.build: Build magic resistance to counter Vel’Koz’s magic damage, and get health as well to withstand the true damage from Vel’Koz P Organic Deconstruction and R Life Form Disintegration Ray. The source doesn’t specify which item to buy first.
Velkoz.escape: You don’t need to wait for Vel’Koz’s mobility ability to be used. The moment after dodging Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption is an opportunity to engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance. If you get too close, Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption can knock you away, so make sure it’s down.
Velkoz.phase: In the late game, health items increase both sapling explosion damage and your durability, so keep taking on the roles of engaging and protecting your allies.
Velkoz.teamfight: From a narrow passage or flank, start Maokai R Nature’s Grasp from range to give it enough time to travel to Vel’Koz. When Vel’Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray begins, knock him back with Maokai Q Bramble Smash at close range to interrupt the channel. If it’s difficult to engage, stay beside your allied damage dealer, use Maokai Q Bramble Smash to knock away an enemy who has engaged, and root them with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Velkoz.watch: With Vel’Koz Q Plasma Fission, you also need to dodge the split beams, so don’t only move sideways; dodge toward Vel’Koz or behind where the beams pass. If Vel’Koz W Void Rift and E Tectonic Disruption hit in succession, Vel’Koz P Organic Deconstruction triggers true damage, so if you have stacks, back off and let them fade.

Bard.watch: Bard Q Cosmic Binding stuns when it hits a wall or a second target. Don’t stand with your back to a wall or in a line with an ally or minion. A target affected by Bard R Tempered Fate takes no damage, so wait for the effect to end before dealing damage.
Bard.fight: Start a trade with Maokai W Twisted Advance when your allied ranged carry can follow up and the lane is closer to your side. Don’t focus damage while Bard R Tempered Fate is making its targets immune to damage.
Bard.build: Build magic resistance before armor to withstand Bard’s damage. If you’re often focused after being stunned by Bard Q Cosmic Binding, get tenacity too. Movement speed is also useful for getting out of telegraphed attack areas.
Bard.combo: Your basic combo is Maokai W Twisted Advance → a basic attack empowered by your passive → Maokai Q Bramble Smash. After Bard E Magical Journey is down, root him from range with Maokai R Nature’s Grasp, then use the movement speed increase to follow up with Maokai W Twisted Advance. If you need to push Bard toward your team, use Maokai W Twisted Advance to pass him and land on the other side, then cast Maokai Q Bramble Smash.
Bard.escape: Immediately after you make Bard use Bard E Magical Journey, you have an opening to engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance. If Bard Q Cosmic Binding is down, look for an engage without worrying as much about its stun. Before following him through a portal, check that the exit is safe.
Bard.laning: Use Maokai E Sapling Toss to control both bushes, and walk over Bard W Caretaker’s Shrine to destroy it when you see one. Don’t force the wave forward or waste Maokai Q Bramble Smash on minions.
Bard.phase: In the late game, health items increase both your sapling explosion damage and your durability, letting you continue to initiate.
Bard.teamfight: At narrow choke points such as the entrances to Dragon or Baron pits, send Maokai R Nature’s Grasp toward the flank or rear. Spread Maokai E Sapling Toss along side routes Bard could use with Bard E Magical Journey to watch for his engage. If initiating is unfavorable, stay near your allied damage dealers, knock away an approaching enemy with Maokai Q Bramble Smash, and root them with Maokai W Twisted Advance.

Janna.laning: Use Maokai E Sapling Toss to control both side bushes, and don’t force the wave forward. Pressure one of Janna’s allies whom she is protecting until she uses Janna E Eye Of The Storm, then start a trade with Maokai W Twisted Advance only when your allied damage dealer can follow up. Don’t waste Maokai Q Bramble Smash on minions.
Janna.build: The provided information isn’t enough to determine your first purchase. If you need resistance against Janna’s damage, magic resistance is useful, but you rarely need to build resistance early just because of Janna herself.
Janna.combo: The basic combo is Maokai W Twisted Advance → a passive-empowered basic attack → Maokai Q Bramble Smash. If you use Q first, Janna gets knocked back and the gap opens. To initiate with Maokai R Nature’s Grasp, cast it from a distance to increase its root duration, then use the movement speed gained after it hits to approach and follow up with W.
Janna.escape: When Janna Q Howling Gale is down, you have an opening to engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance. If Janna R Monsoon is also down, there’s less risk of your engage being knocked back. Account for Janna W Zephyr’s movement speed and ability to pass through minions; use W’s root to catch her rather than trying to block her path.
Janna.fight: Look for an opening when Janna Q Howling Gale is down and she has used Janna E Eye Of The Storm. If you want to knock Janna toward your allies, use W to pass through her and land behind her, then use Q.
Janna.phase: As you build health items in the late game, Maokai’s sapling explosions and durability both increase, so continue initiating fights and protecting allies.
Janna.teamfight: Get vision and look for a moment when Janna is isolated, or cast Maokai R Nature’s Grasp from the side of a narrow passage. Since Janna R Monsoon can knock back your engage, choose a position where you can keep your back to a wall. If the situation makes engaging difficult, stand beside your allied damage dealer, knock away an approaching enemy with Maokai Q Bramble Smash, then root them with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Janna.watch: The longer Janna Q Howling Gale charges, the farther it travels and the longer it knocks enemies up, so avoid its path if you hear it from a bush or out of sight. Janna R Monsoon can knock back a fight started with Maokai W Twisted Advance, so engage with your back to a wall if possible. Don’t focus your damage on a target protected by Janna E Eye Of The Storm.

Rell.laning: Plant Maokai E Sapling Toss in both side bushes to watch for Rell's approach. Rell has low magic resistance early and no sustain in lane, so poke from outside her engage range. Keep the wave on your side, and only start a trade with Maokai W Twisted Advance when your allied damage dealer can attack.
Rell.teamfight: Spread out from allies before engaging so you aren't pulled in together by Rell R Magnet Storm. Send Maokai R Nature's Grasp from afar through the side of a narrow passage, then follow up with Maokai W Twisted Advance if it hits. If Rell engages on an allied damage dealer, stand beside them, knock her away with Maokai Q Bramble Smash, then root her with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Rell.watch: If Rell E Full Tilt speeds up Rell and one ally, watch for an engage with Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down and retreat out of range. Rell Q Shattering Strike can stun and break shields, so sidestep out of its straight path. Before a team fight, spread out from allies so multiple people aren't pulled in by Rell R Magnet Storm.
Rell.build: Buy magic resistance items first against Rell's main damage. Avoid stacking only health because Rell P Break the Mold reduces resistances, and Rell E Full Tilt deals damage based on maximum health.
Rell.combo: The basic order is Maokai W Twisted Advance → a basic attack empowered by your passive → Maokai Q Bramble Smash. If you need to knock Rell toward your allies, land beyond her with Maokai W Twisted Advance, then use Maokai Q Bramble Smash. To initiate from afar, send Maokai R Nature's Grasp first to root her, then follow with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Rell.escape: Don't go in just because Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down is down; check whether Rell E Full Tilt is also down. In particular, close the gap with Maokai W Twisted Advance and block her escape route with Maokai R Nature's Grasp before Rell E Full Tilt comes back up.
Rell.fight: Poke with saplings from outside Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range, then look for an opening after Rell uses W. Engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance and root her when your allied damage dealer can attack. If Rell engages on them, knock her away with Maokai Q Bramble Smash.
Rell.phase: In the late game, Maokai's sapling burst and durability both increase, so keep initiating and protecting allies.

Senna.fight: When Senna steps forward to collect a soul, use Maokai W Twisted Advance to engage if your allied damage dealer is in range to attack. After Senna hits you once, don’t prolong the standoff and let her hit you a second time; manage your distance.
Senna.laning: Use Maokai E Sapling Toss to control the bottom-lane bushes and watch where Senna steps up for souls or CS. Don’t force the wave forward; keep it near your side to create opportunities to engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance. Save Maokai Q Bramble Smash for fights and peel instead of wasting it on minions.
Senna.watch: Senna W Last Embrace has a delay before it roots after hitting, so move away from your allies if you are marked. Senna Q Piercing Darkness travels in a straight line through allies or minions, so don’t stand along its path. If Senna hits you once, reposition so you can dodge her next attack and prevent her from collecting Mist.
Senna.build: Senna’s main damage is physical, so build armor first and consider Dead Man’s Plate or Thornmail. Senna P Absolution deals current-health-based damage, so don’t stack health alone; build armor as well.
Senna.combo: The basic combo is Maokai W Twisted Advance → a passive-empowered basic attack → Maokai Q Bramble Smash. To push Senna toward your allies, use W to pass through her and land on the other side, then cast Q. If you hit her from afar with Maokai R Nature’s Grasp, use the movement speed bonus to follow up with W.
Senna.escape: After Senna uses W Last Embrace, dodge the root, then engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance. Senna E Curse of the Black Mist grants movement speed, but she has no mobility ability to create distance on her own, so once you close the gap, catch her with Maokai R Nature’s Grasp.
Senna.phase: Senna’s range and attack damage scale into the late game, so disrupt her soul collection early. Use Maokai’s bush saplings and durability to find opportunities to engage.
Senna.teamfight: When you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, back off to a place where you have vision, or block the approach routes with Maokai E Sapling Toss and Q Bramble Smash. To engage, cast Maokai R Nature’s Grasp from range from a flank or narrow passage, then follow up with W. If an enemy engages on an allied damage dealer, stay by them, use Q to knock the enemy away, and root them with W.

Swain.laning: Use Maokai E Sapling Toss to control the bottom-lane bushes, and trade with your allied damage dealer when Swain steps forward. Don’t force the wave all the way to the enemy turret; keep it on your side so there’s room to engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance and get back out. Dodge Swain E Nevermove’s path while creating an angle for your jungler to enter.
Swain.teamfight: From a flank or narrow passage, roll Maokai R Nature’s Grasp from range to root enemies, then use the movement speed bonus to follow up with Maokai W Twisted Advance. Don’t keep fighting near Swain while R Demonic Ascension is active; move out of range and wait for it to end. If you need to protect an allied damage dealer, stay beside them, use Maokai Q Bramble Smash to knock away an enemy who has engaged, and root them with W.
Swain.build: Build magic resistance first to counter damage from Swain Q, W, and E. If you expect an extended fight, get Grievous Wounds next to reduce healing from Swain P Ravenous Flock and R Demonic Ascension. If an allied damage dealer is rooted by Swain E Nevermove and focused down, prioritize Mikael’s Blessing over Locket of the Iron Solari.
Swain.combo: When Swain E Nevermove is down, use Maokai W Twisted Advance → a passive-empowered basic attack → Maokai Q Bramble Smash. Using Maokai Q Bramble Smash first knocks Swain outward and creates distance. To send him toward your allies, use W to pass through him and land on the other side, then cast Q.
Swain.escape: Swain cannot escape with a mobility ability, so close the gap with Maokai W Twisted Advance immediately after Swain E Nevermove is spent. Engage only after confirming that its returning wave has disappeared as well.
Swain.fight: The moment after Swain E Nevermove is down is an opportunity to engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Swain.phase: Early on, Swain P Ravenous Flock has not yet built up its growth stacks, so it’s better to pressure him then. In the mid game, Maokai R Nature’s Grasp can start roams and objective fights. In the late game, Swain’s permanent health growth and healing make fights more unfavorable over time, so build Grievous Wounds and fight.
Swain.watch: Swain E Nevermove travels out and then returns, so after dodging the first wave, stay clear of its path until it disappears completely. Swain Q Death’s Hand fires several bolts that overlap at close range, so keep your distance. When Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, move out of range and wait for it to end.

Heimerdinger.fight: Don’t repeatedly fight in front of Heimerdinger’s turret setup. Approach Heimerdinger himself from the side or through a bush, and engage when your allies can attack with you.
Heimerdinger.laning: Don’t risk last-hitting within turret range. Wait until a grenade is down or Heimerdinger has used all his turret deployment charges. Use Maokai E Sapling Toss to control the bushes, and don’t force the wave forward; create room to fight near your side. If you need health, use basic attacks empowered by Maokai P Sap Magic on minions too.
Heimerdinger.teamfight: From a flank or in a narrow corridor, send Maokai R Nature’s Grasp from range to root Heimerdinger, then close in on him with Maokai W Twisted Advance. If Heimerdinger R UPGRADE!!! is ready, don’t group with your allies at one spot in front of an objective. When engaging is difficult, stay beside your allied damage dealers, knock away an approaching enemy with Maokai Q Bramble Smash, and root them with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Heimerdinger.build: Heimerdinger’s turrets, rockets, and grenades all deal magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Consider movement speed to help you get out of telegraphed attack areas.
Heimerdinger.combo: Your basic trade is Maokai W Twisted Advance → a basic attack empowered by Maokai P Sap Magic → Maokai Q Bramble Smash. If you use Maokai Q Bramble Smash first, Heimerdinger will be pushed away and the gap will widen. Start Maokai R Nature’s Grasp from range to extend the root, then use the movement speed increase to follow up with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Heimerdinger.escape: Look to engage just after a turret is placed or finishes a powerful shot. If you’re hit by a grenade, leave turret range instead of continuing the engage.
Heimerdinger.phase: Early on, Heimerdinger’s turrets and rockets make it difficult to last-hit within turret range or trade head-on. In the late game, health items increase both your sapling explosion damage and durability, letting you continue to initiate.
Heimerdinger.watch: If you’re hit by a grenade, don’t stay within turret range.

Karma.laning: Use Maokai E Sapling Toss to control the bottom-lane bushes, and dodge Karma Q Inner Flame from behind minions or outside its range. Don’t force the wave forward; keep it on your side.
Karma.build: Since Karma’s primary damage is magic, build magic resistance first. If your allied damage dealer is being focused while immobilized by an effect such as Karma W Focused Resolve, buy Mikael’s Blessing before Locket of the Iron Solari.
Karma.combo: Cast Maokai R Nature’s Grasp from a distance to root the enemy, then use the movement speed it grants to follow up with Maokai W Twisted Advance. Once you’re in range, heal with a Maokai P Sap Magic-empowered basic attack, then use Maokai Q Bramble Smash. If you use Maokai Q Bramble Smash first, the enemy is knocked back and the gap opens.
Karma.escape: Engage after Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the shield from empowered Karma E Inspire has ended. Close the gap and root with Maokai W Twisted Advance, then follow up with Maokai R Nature’s Grasp.
Karma.fight: Force Karma W Focused Resolve first, then engage after the shield from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra has ended. When your allied damage dealer can attack alongside you, close in and root Karma with Maokai W Twisted Advance. Karma has relatively low magic resistance, so Maokai’s magic damage also deals good damage to her.
Karma.phase: As you build health items in the late game, Maokai E Sapling Toss’s explosion damage and Maokai’s durability both increase, so continue initiating fights.
Karma.teamfight: Delay your engage if Karma W Focused Resolve is available or the shield from empowered Karma E Inspire is active. From the side of a narrow passage, cast Maokai R Nature’s Grasp from a distance to root the enemy, then follow up with Maokai W Twisted Advance. When you need to protect your allied damage dealer, stand beside them, knock away an enemy who gets close with Maokai Q Bramble Smash, then root them with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Karma.watch: If you keep getting hit by Karma Q Inner Flame, she’ll be able to use Karma R Mantra more often, so reposition behind minions or outside its range. Walk out of the circle left by empowered Karma Q Inner Flame before it detonates again. If Karma W Focused Resolve tethers you, create distance and break the tether before it roots you.

Pyke.laning: Control the bottom bushes with Maokai E Sapling Toss, and engage when an enemy steps forward and your allied damage dealer can land basic attacks. Don't force the wave forward, and save Maokai Q Bramble Smash to counter Pyke's engage. If Pyke retreats after a trade, maintain vision to prevent healing from Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones.
Pyke.watch: If a shark shadow appears beneath you while Pyke W Ghostwater Dive is active, you're already in range, so retreat toward your allies. Pyke E Phantom Undertow leaves a stun along his dash path, so dodge to the side of the direction he came from. Watch for Pyke R Death From Below when your health is low, and don't stand beside an injured ally.
Pyke.build: Pyke deals physical damage and builds armor penetration, so secure health first to stay above Pyke R Death From Below's threshold. Build armor rather than magic resistance, and consider Dead Man's Plate or Thornmail.
Pyke.combo: If Pyke's mobility is down, send Maokai R Nature's Grasp from afar to look for a root. Follow with Maokai W Twisted Advance to close in and root him, heal with a basic attack empowered by Maokai P Sap Magic, then use Maokai Q Bramble Smash.
Pyke.escape: Right after dodging Pyke E Phantom Undertow is your chance to engage. If Pyke R Death From Below is also down, close the gap with Maokai W Twisted Advance and use Maokai R Nature's Grasp to stop his escape. Keep in mind that Pyke can still escape with his remaining mobility if only one of his movement tools is down.
Pyke.fight: If you dodge Pyke E Phantom Undertow to the side, look for the window when his engage and escape tools are down. Engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance from a range where your allied damage dealer can attack, root him, and deal damage together.
Pyke.phase: In the late game, health items reduce the risk of being executed, and stay with squishy allies Pyke might target.
Pyke.teamfight: If Pyke engages on an allied damage dealer, stand between them and Pyke, knock him away with Maokai Q Bramble Smash, then root him with Maokai W Twisted Advance. Keep your distance from low-health allies to reduce the risk of Pyke R Death From Below chaining. When you have a chance to initiate, send Maokai R Nature's Grasp through a flank or narrow passage.

Sona.laning: Use Maokai E Sapling Toss to control both bushes, and pressure Sona with your allied damage dealer when she steps forward to farm CS or apply her aura. Don’t force the wave forward; keep it closer to your side so there’s room to engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance and get back out. Don’t waste Maokai Q Bramble Smash on minions.
Sona.teamfight: Spread out to either side of your allies so Sona R Crescendo doesn’t hit multiple people, and engage with Maokai R Nature’s Grasp from a narrow passage or flank. If an enemy is on top of your allied damage dealer, stay by them, use Maokai Q Bramble Smash to knock the enemy away, and root them with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Sona.build: Build magic resistance first to counter Sona’s main damage. In the late game, make sure your team has at least one Grievous Wounds item to counter healing from Sona W Aria of Perseverance.
Sona.combo: The basic combo is Maokai W Twisted Advance → a basic attack empowered by Maokai P Sap Magic → Maokai Q Bramble Smash. If you need to push Sona toward your allies, use Maokai W Twisted Advance to pass through her and land, then cast Maokai Q Bramble Smash. If you can engage from range, send Maokai R Nature’s Grasp first to root her, then follow up with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Sona.escape: The opportunity to engage comes when Sona R Crescendo is down or when she steps forward to apply her aura. Immobilize her first with Maokai W Twisted Advance or Maokai R Nature’s Grasp before she creates distance with Sona E Song of Celerity.
Sona.fight: When Sona steps forward to apply her aura, engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance to start a trade if your allied ranged damage dealer can attack alongside you. Root her before she speeds up with Sona E Song of Celerity, then recover health with a Maokai P Sap Magic empowered basic attack.
Sona.phase: In the late game, Sona’s scaling and sustained healing make extended fights unfavorable, so disrupt enemy positioning with Maokai’s engage and don’t let the fight drag on.
Sona.watch: Sona R Crescendo stuns all allies in a straight line, so spread out to either side of your allies when Sona steps forward. If Sona suddenly moves into basic attack range, watch out for the empowered attack from Sona P Power Chord and create distance.

Zyra.fight: After dodging Zyra E Grasping Roots to the side, close the distance with Maokai W Twisted Advance from an area without plants. Engage when your allied damage dealers can follow up.
Zyra.laning: Control the bushes with Maokai E Sapling Toss and keep the lane closer to your side. If Zyra E Grasping Roots misses and Zyra steps forward to last-hit, root her with Maokai W Twisted Advance if your allied damage dealers can reach her with basic attacks. Step on Zyra’s seeds to destroy them when it’s safe, but back away when she uses an ability.
Zyra.build: Build magic resistance rather than armor to withstand the damage from Zyra P Garden of Thorns, Zyra Q Deadly Spines, and Zyra E Grasping Roots. If Zyra is locking down an allied damage dealer with immobilizing crowd control and focusing attacks on them, prioritize Mikael’s Blessing over Locket of the Iron Solari.
Zyra.combo: When Zyra E Grasping Roots is down, use Maokai W Twisted Advance → a basic attack empowered by Maokai P Sap Magic → Maokai Q Bramble Smash. To knock Zyra toward your allies with Maokai Q Bramble Smash, land Maokai W Twisted Advance past her, then use Q. If you can initiate from afar, cast Maokai R Nature’s Grasp first, then follow it with W.
Zyra.escape: Zyra has no ability to create distance on her own, so the moment after you dodge Zyra E Grasping Roots is your chance to engage. Close in with Maokai W Twisted Advance to root her, then follow up with Maokai R Nature’s Grasp to catch her.
Zyra.phase: In the late game, Maokai’s sapling explosions and durability both increase, but avoid fighting where Zyra has built up plants.
Zyra.teamfight: Avoid areas where Zyra has held position for a long time and built up seeds and plants. Initiate with Maokai R Nature’s Grasp from different terrain or a narrow passage. When you see Zyra R Stranglethorns, leave its area and use Maokai W Twisted Advance if needed.
Zyra.watch: If Zyra E Grasping Roots roots you, you can take repeated plant damage, so dodge E by moving to the side at the edge of its range. When you see the cast indicator for Zyra R Stranglethorns, leave the area and use Maokai W Twisted Advance to escape if needed. Briefly back away from areas with many plants and fight after they disappear.

Blitzcrank.fight: Right after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses, use Maokai W Twisted Advance to close in and trade if your allied damage dealer can follow up with basic attacks. Don’t use Maokai Q Bramble Smash before engaging; use it after you’ve caught him so the gap doesn’t widen first.
Blitzcrank.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank R Static Field. Blitzcrank E Power Fist deals physical damage, which magic resistance can’t block, so don’t expect it to mitigate that damage.
Blitzcrank.combo: If you root him first with Maokai R Nature’s Grasp from range, use the movement speed increase to follow up with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Blitzcrank.escape: Right after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses is your chance to engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance. If Blitzcrank E Power Fist has already been used too, the risk of being hit by chained crowd control is lower, so you can engage.
Blitzcrank.laning: Spread Maokai E Sapling Toss through the bushes. Walk well away from bushes without vision, since you can’t judge the range of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab from there. In lane, stand behind minions to block the hook, and don’t force the wave forward; leave room to get out after using Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Blitzcrank.phase: In the late game, health items increase both Maokai’s sapling explosion damage and durability, letting you continue to initiate.
Blitzcrank.teamfight: Instead of chasing only Blitzcrank, start a fight by casting Maokai R Nature’s Grasp at the enemies in the back from a flank or through a narrow corridor. If an enemy gets onto your allied damage dealer, stay beside the damage dealer and protect them by knocking the enemy away with Maokai Q Bramble Smash and rooting them with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Blitzcrank.watch: Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab pulls the first target it hits, so keep a minion in front of you to block it. If you’re pulled in, Blitzcrank E Power Fist can knock you up, followed by the silence from Blitzcrank R Static Field. Keep your distance, especially near bushes without vision.

Leona.laning: Use Maokai E Sapling Toss to control both side bushes, and don’t force the wave forward. Given Leona’s high early armor, instead of trading damage first with physical damage, counterattack with your allied damage dealer after Leona E Zenith Blade is down. Save Maokai Q Bramble Smash to counter Leona’s engage rather than wasting it on minions.
Leona.watch: Leona E Zenith Blade pierces in a straight line and attaches Leona to the last champion hit, so don’t stand in a line with your allied marksman. Leona can activate Q Shield of Daybreak before approaching, so watch whether she can reach you rather than whether she has used the ability. When the indicator for Leona R Solar Flare appears, sidestep to avoid the stun at its center.
Leona.build: If Leona is locking down and eliminating your allied damage dealer with crowd control, buy Mikael’s Blessing before Locket of the Iron Solari. Choose resistances based on the damage type of the enemy damage dealer dealing damage during Leona’s crowd control.
Leona.combo: When Leona E Zenith Blade is down and your allied damage dealer can follow up, use Maokai W Twisted Advance → a passive-empowered basic attack → Maokai Q Bramble Smash. If you use Maokai Q Bramble Smash first, Leona gets knocked back and the gap opens. To knock Leona toward your allies, use Maokai W Twisted Advance to pass through her and land on the other side, then use Maokai Q Bramble Smash.
Leona.escape: Engage right after forcing Leona to use her only mobility tool, Leona E Zenith Blade. If Leona Q Shield of Daybreak is still available, she can activate it before approaching, so watch both the distance she can cover and the stun threat.
Leona.fight: Right after Leona E Zenith Blade is down is your chance to close the gap with Maokai W Twisted Advance. Engage only when your allied damage dealer can follow up with basic attacks, and move out of range before Leona W Eclipse explodes if she activates it.
Leona.phase: As you build health items in the late game, Maokai E Sapling Toss’s explosion damage and Maokai’s durability both increase, letting you continue initiating fights.
Leona.teamfight: If Leona reaches your allied damage dealer, stand between them and use Maokai Q Bramble Smash to knock her away, then root her with Maokai W Twisted Advance. If Leona P Sunlight marks you, back off and watch for the enemy follow-up. To initiate, cast Maokai R Nature’s Grasp from a distance along a flank or narrow passage, then follow up with Maokai W Twisted Advance.

Morgana.laning: Use Maokai E Sapling Toss to control the bottom-lane bushes, and dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding with a minion between you. Keep the wave on your side and use Maokai W Twisted Advance only when your allied damage dealer can land basic attacks. Save Maokai Q Bramble Smash to counter an enemy engage rather than wasting it on minions.
Morgana.build: Build magic resistance first against Morgana’s primary damage. If your allied damage dealer is caught by Morgana Q Dark Binding or Morgana R Soul Shackles and focused, buy Mikael’s Blessing before Locket of the Iron Solari.
Morgana.combo: If Morgana E Black Shield is down, attack in this order: Maokai W Twisted Advance → a passive-empowered basic attack → Maokai Q Bramble Smash. If you use Maokai Q Bramble Smash first, Morgana gets knocked back and the gap opens. To initiate from a distance, send Maokai R Nature’s Grasp first and let the wall travel far enough, then follow up with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Morgana.escape: Dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding and look to engage when Morgana E Black Shield is down. Morgana has no ability to create distance herself, so close in and root her with Maokai W Twisted Advance. If Morgana R Soul Shackles connects, use Maokai W Twisted Advance to get out of range before the stun triggers.
Morgana.fight: Dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding and engage after Morgana E Black Shield is down. When your allied damage dealer is within range to attack alongside you, close in and root Morgana with Maokai W Twisted Advance, then trade damage while healing with a passive-empowered basic attack. Maokai’s magic damage deals good damage to Morgana because she has low magic resistance.
Morgana.phase: In the late game, Maokai can continue initiating fights with sapling explosions and durability.
Morgana.teamfight: When Morgana E Black Shield is down, send Maokai R Nature’s Grasp from a flank or narrow passage. If the wall hits an enemy champion, use the movement speed it grants to follow up with Maokai W Twisted Advance. If an enemy reaches your allied damage dealer, knock them away with Maokai Q Bramble Smash from beside your ally, then root them with Maokai W Twisted Advance. Before an objective fight, place Maokai E Sapling Toss along each enemy approach.
Morgana.watch: If Morgana Q Dark Binding hits you, Morgana W Tormented Shadow and follow-up attacks will come next, so dodge it with a minion between you. When your health is low, don’t walk through Morgana W Tormented Shadow. If Morgana R Soul Shackles catches you, use Maokai W Twisted Advance to get out of range before the stun triggers.

Taric.fight: After dodging Taric E Dazzle, engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance when your allied damage dealer can land basic attacks. Use Maokai Q Bramble Smash to create distance so you don’t keep taking empowered attacks from Taric P Bravado.
Taric.laning: Use Maokai E Sapling Toss to control both bushes, and don’t force the wave forward. When the enemy steps up to farm CS, check your allied damage dealer’s range, then catch them with Maokai W Twisted Advance. Save Maokai Q Bramble Smash for an enemy engage instead of wasting it on minions.
Taric.build: Choose a first defensive item that provides magic resistance. Taric P Bravado and Taric E Dazzle deal magic damage, so magic resistance is more effective than armor.
Taric.combo: When Taric E Dazzle is down, trade with Maokai W Twisted Advance → a basic attack empowered by Maokai P Sap Magic → Maokai Q Bramble Smash. Casting Q first knocks Taric away and creates distance. If you have an angle to hit Taric from range with Maokai R Nature’s Grasp, root him with R, then use the movement speed bonus to follow up with W.
Taric.escape: The moment after Taric E Dazzle is down is an opportunity to engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance. Taric has no ability to create distance on his own, so after catching him, you can extend the root with Maokai R Nature’s Grasp.
Taric.phase: Early on, Taric P Bravado deals strong damage at close range, so don’t force a fight. In the late game, health items increase both the explosion damage of Maokai E Sapling Toss and your durability, letting you keep playing the engage role.
Taric.teamfight: From the side or back of a narrow passage, roll Maokai R Nature’s Grasp from range to look for a root. While Taric R Cosmic Radiance’s damage immunity is active, keep enemies rooted with Maokai W Twisted Advance or R, then let your allies deal damage after it ends.
Taric.watch: When you see the tell for Taric E Dazzle, move sideways to dodge it. When Taric R Cosmic Radiance activates damage immunity, don’t pour in damage; use roots to wait it out.

Xerath.laning: In bot lane, control the bushes with Maokai E Sapling Toss and fight within range of your allied damage dealers when the enemy steps forward. Don’t force the push; survive while avoiding heavy poke. When Xerath runs out of mana, push the lane and call your jungler.
Xerath.teamfight: Use Maokai R Nature’s Grasp from a distance on a flank or through a narrow passage, then follow it with Maokai W Twisted Advance when it reaches Xerath. If Xerath is channeling Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, that’s a chance to engage on him while he can’t move. When protecting your allies matters more than engaging, stay near your damage dealers, use Maokai Q Bramble Smash to peel enemies off them, and root them with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Xerath.build: First, have a way to cleanse or remove the stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb. Xerath deals magic damage, so build magic resistance and prioritize movement speed to get out of the way of his telegraphed attacks.
Xerath.combo: The basic combo is Maokai W Twisted Advance → empowered basic attack → Maokai Q Bramble Smash. If you use Maokai Q Bramble Smash first, it knocks Xerath back and creates distance. If you start Maokai R Nature’s Grasp from afar, follow it with Maokai W Twisted Advance after the wall has moved.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility, so the moment Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down is your chance to engage. Close the distance while dodging to the side as he charges Xerath Q Arcanopulse.
Xerath.fight: Engage with Maokai W Twisted Advance as soon as Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down. Go in when your allied damage dealers can follow up, then heal with an empowered basic attack during the root before using Maokai Q Bramble Smash.
Xerath.phase: As you build health items in the late game, your sapling explosions and durability both increase, letting you keep initiating fights.
Xerath.watch: If Xerath E Shocking Orb stuns you, he can follow up with a string of attacks, so dodge this ability first. Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so move well to the side when you see him charging it. When you see the cast animation for Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, dodge immediately or engage on Xerath.

Nami.laning: Use Maokai E Sapling Toss to control the bottom-lane bushes and make them difficult for Nami to use. Don’t force the wave forward; when Nami steps up, close in with Maokai W Twisted Advance alongside your allied marksman. Save Maokai Q Bramble Smash to counter an enemy engage rather than wasting it on minions.
Nami.build: Consider Morellonomicon first to reduce healing from Nami W Ebb and Flow. Build magic resistance rather than armor against the damage from Nami Q Aqua Prison, W Ebb and Flow, and E Tidecaller’s Blessing.
Nami.combo: The basic combo is Maokai W Twisted Advance → a Maokai P Sap Magic-empowered basic attack → Maokai Q Bramble Smash. To knock Nami toward your allies, use Maokai W Twisted Advance to pass through her and land behind her, then use Maokai Q Bramble Smash. If you can hit her with Maokai R Nature’s Grasp from a distance, use its root and movement speed to follow up with Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Nami.escape: Nami has no mobility ability, so the moment after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses is your chance to close the gap. Sidestep when you see Nami R Tidal Wave, and save Maokai W Twisted Advance for the Nami Q Aqua Prison that follows. Re-engage after Nami E Tidecaller’s Blessing expires.
Nami.fight: Right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, target Nami from within range for your allied marksman to land basic attacks. Close in and root her with Maokai W Twisted Advance, heal with a Maokai P Sap Magic-empowered basic attack, then use Maokai Q Bramble Smash.
Nami.phase: As you build health items in the late game, the explosion damage from Maokai E Sapling Toss and Maokai’s durability both increase, letting you continue initiating fights.
Nami.teamfight: Cast Maokai R Nature’s Grasp from a distance along a narrow passage or flank to look for a root, then follow up with Maokai W Twisted Advance if it hits. When you need to protect your allied damage dealer, stand beside them, knock away an enemy who gets close with Maokai Q Bramble Smash, then root them with Maokai W Twisted Advance. Before an objective fight, place one Maokai E Sapling Toss on each approach.
Nami.watch: Nami Q Aqua Prison stuns but falls slowly, so sidestep when you see it coming. Also sidestep Nami R Tidal Wave, and save Maokai W Twisted Advance for the Nami Q Aqua Prison that follows. Avoid trading while Nami E Tidecaller’s Blessing is active.
